product.name: DALIL
product.tagline: AML investigation copilot — evidence-linked score and template note, optional experimental local-LLM draft; no external AI API; synthetic demo data
product.partner: MKBANK FCC (proposed pilot client — partnership not confirmed)
product.regulator_context: Central Bank of Uzbekistan AML/CFT reporting requirements

data_sources.name: DALIL synthetic casebook
data_sources.note: Generated by data/generator/generate.py (seed 20261010). 3880 cases total across train/test/novel/demo. See DATA_CARD.md.

data_sources.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (GGUF Q4_K_M)
data_sources.note: Optional experimental draft model (local llama.cpp). Drafts are checked for citation IDs and numbers; meaning is not verified.

data_sources.name: llama.cpp prebuilt server (b11541, ubuntu-x64)
data_sources.note: Local OpenAI-compatible inference runtime; no external AI API is called.

data_sources.name: scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingClassifier
data_sources.note: Risk model trained on the synthetic casebook; weights shipped as model/dalil_model.joblib.

cost_model.basis: Illustrative planning scenario only; no bank pilot or commercial quote.
cost_model.sensitivity: At 2000 alerts/month: $750 net benefit; 8-month payback after rollout.
cost_model.assumptions_note: Every volume, time saving and cost above is assumed. Capacity value is not automatically a cash saving. Production rollout needs security, data mapping and model validation.

latency_measured.note: 16-core laptop; LLM = Qwen2.5-1.5B Q4 on 4 threads, measured by eval/run_eval.py on 11 Oct

metrics_summary.note: LLM draft metrics cover citation IDs and numbers/dates only; meaning is not measured.

deployment.public_demo: presenter's laptop behind an ngrok tunnel; synthetic data only; not a bank environment
deployment.egress: no external AI API is called; outbound traffic of host/tunnel not audited
deployment.storage: data/analyses/*.json and data/audit/audit.log on local disk; Docker needs volumes
